III, 1</cite> <he>כל שיש בידו … או כ׳</he> a statue holding in its hand … a ball (globe); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 41a:4">ib. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ שתופש את עצמו … וככ׳</he> the ball (means symbolically) that he causes himself to be caught like a ball in behalf of the entire world (vicarious sacrifice); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:14">Num.
